recipe.criteria: Lie on side, lower arm supporting head. Hold a light dumbbell with upper elbow bent ninety degrees and upper arm kept alongside torso. Rotate forearm upward sixty degrees and lower with control; pelvis and legs stay still. 3.5 seconds raise, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative; lower only while keeping the back supported.
